floorPlans.introduction: Compare the original three- and four-bedroom townhouse layouts, the attached villas and the garden villa. The Plus plans include a second floor.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Bay Estate residence plan
floorPlans.note: The areas are the totals printed on each Nakheel drawing. Layouts and finishes may change. Villa plots follow separate design guidelines and are sold without a fixed residence plan.

review.images: Eight native renders from the original Nakheel Bay Estate brochure, covering the estate, garden villa, attached villa, townhouses and lagoon.
review.location: The Nakheel project page’s Bay Estate directions link resolves to the published 25.324297, 55.340667 development marker. The project-level map and six time estimates come from original brochure page 10 and agree with the developer microsite. A broker publishes a different point within the estate. The page identifies Nakheel’s location as a development marker.
review.floorPlans: All 15 full residence sheets from the official plan book downloaded through Nakheel’s public Box link. Exact total areas and every level were checked visually. Pages 34–35 and 39–40 of the separate villa plots brochure show indicative plot envelopes and controls, not fixed floor plans. Plot source https://dubaiholding.box.com/s/un8kg9t4tuuh5vxa9r85kb47otuk8wdz.
